title: Underwater navigation sensors calibration in inland water spaces
authors: B. Matias; J. Almeida; A. Ferreira; A. Martins; H. Ferreira; E. Silva
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
